description: Code and data reproduce the case application of a topological algorithm for water-network sectorisation. This resource is provided by Giovanni Francesco Santonastaso; Armando Di Nardo; Enrico Creaco and coauthors. Its method is not tied to one place; geographic inputs and simulation resolution depend on the user configuration. The provider lists ZIP formats or archive containers, accessible through the linked landing page. Licence: CC-BY-4.0. The public page or repository can be accessed free of charge. Limitation: The deposit provides a study package, not evidence of a maintained general tool. For simulation, it can support model-based scenario analysis. Related catalogue record: model-epanet. This is a thematic comparison, not evidence that the resource was used with that model.
